---
<!-- shot -->

Plain paragraphs are the default river: **spoken** and never on screen, with `code` and *emphasis* surviving into the notes.

A second paragraph on the same screen is a second voice block; the screen still speaks as one unit.

<!-- shot -->

Heading-free screens still speak. The document view is the whole voice as prose; the slide stays quiet until a heading, quote, list, or role object is written.
